## Relation to Library 1.14

VegetationGenerator 1.14.0 is a retained historical learning baseline, not the current online product version. The actual 1.14 files remain byte-identical. Two original TypeScript modules from that baseline were run locally and passed ten assertions; this does not establish identity with the current 5.0.0-rc.2 source.

The Site's source snapshot metadata describes 390 files, 101,191,680 bytes and hash sha256:5d397cda9f66d069de0d63c278c1d1723c63c40905b76bd5ab78f5630a155507. Its official archive read did not resolve an authorized local file. Source inspection and integration are paused at that boundary. No alternative archive route or write credential was used.

The cloud browser can confirm the current title, but reports no WebGPU or WebGL2 support. This is an environment limit, not evidence that the live workbench is broken. The Site has not received a full runtime regression in this environment.

## Integration rule

Do not replace the existing 5.0 mother with a 1.14 export or this standalone study. First obtain the current source through a supported authorized route, identify its existing navigation and state boundaries, then add an isolated self-study entry while preserving original tools, assets, saved projects and audience. The current GitHub QA branch tests our independent module only and is not the live mother.
